withheld.reason: Primary source (Intel MCS-4 datasheet) not read: value comes from a third-party transcription (pyntel4004) that does not cite its source; Intel secondary figures diverge (108 kHz / 740 kHz / 750 kHz). Held back until the original datasheet is consulted.
Derived from intel-4004-min-clock-period, which is held back (primary datasheet not read).

Incomplete protocol: interconnect, MPI library, sample count and which of the two required tests (longest/shortest path, Table 4.6) produced the value are not stated. Verifier flagged it at the limit of 'inadequate'.
Derived with Little's law from an 'up to' marketing IOPS figure with unstated block size: at most a lower bound on mean latency, misleading on a timeline of typical values.
The NVIDIA page does not state whether 296 TFLOPS FP64 is per GPU or for the 8-GPU HGX board (the table mixes per-GPU and total rows): not comparable, withheld (lot-2 verifier note).
